title: Heavenly Fate Bloodline
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was digesting Chen Nian's words, she suddenly lowered her voice and added one final sentence—and this sentence caused Chen Ji's pupils to contract sharply.

text.content: Golden light like the first light of dawn burst forth from where the two fragments converged, dyeing the entire stone chamber in brilliance. Chen Ji instinctively raised his hand to shield his eyes, yet through the gaps between his fingers he saw that light, like a living creature, flowing upstream along his blood vessels, rushing directly into the depths of his heart. The Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace trembled violently, as if it had seen a long-lost relative.

dialogue.content: Brother, do you feel it? This resonance... only blood of the same origin can ignite it.

text.content: Chen Ji's Adam's apple bobbed slightly. He stared at Chen Nian's face, which bore five-tenths resemblance to his own, while his mind raced at lightning speed. If this were a trap set by the Holy Sect, the enemy had gone too far in making it realistic—that tremor from the depths of his blood could not be faked, nor would the Tianji Record's sensing deceive. But after all these years navigating the jianghu, how many exquisite schemes had he not witnessed?

dialogue.content: I know you don't believe me. When the Holy Sect took me away, I was only five, right? But I remember you, remember you hiding me in the woodshed for those three days, remember you saving your own mantou to feed me.

text.content: These words were like a soft blade, piercing directly into Chen Ji's unyielding exterior. He remembered. It was the third day after the Chen family's annihilation. He, an eight-year-old boy, had dragged his three-year-old sister through the snow while fleeing. Later, when pursuers closed in, he had no choice but to shove Chen Nian into a farmer's woodpile and lead the enemies away alone. That farewell was fourteen years.

choice.prompt: Chen Nian mentioned past events, and Chen Ji's heart was shaken. How should he respond to this sudden bloodline reunion?

choices.description: Do not easily believe anything, even if the other party possesses information only a Chen family member would know—continue to verify the truth. The jianghu is treacherous; only by being suspicious can one survive.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more information about Chen Nian's identity
choices.risk_hint: May harm the truly separated sister

text.content: Chen Ji slowly withdrew his hand from shielding his eyes, his expression still typically cold as ever. 'The mantou matter is known only to the two of us.' His voice was terrifyingly calm, 'But this could also have been extracted through interrogation by the Holy Sect—they want to use my weakness as a blade. I've seen too much of that.'

dialogue.content: Brother, how long will you keep testing? Can the Holy Sect extract the origin of the Heavenly Fate Bloodline through interrogation? Can they make the Turtle Shell produce this kind of resonance?

text.content: Chen Nian took a deep breath, clasped the fragment with both hands, and suddenly a ball of golden light ignited in her palm—echoing the faint glow of the Turtle Shell from afar, yet more intense, more pure. That was the power flowing from the depths of her bloodline, the unique mark of the Heavenly Fate Key.

choices.description: Temporarily acknowledge she might be Chen Nian, but the Holy Sect's methods are unpredictable—need to further verify her abilities and stance.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the trust of a potential ally
choices.risk_hint: If she is an insider, may leak the Tianji Record secret

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze finally loosened a fraction. He neither nodded nor shook his head, only saying flatly, 'Even if you are Chen Nian, you must prove you stand on my side. Fourteen years is enough to change a person; I've seen what the Holy Sect can do too.'

dialogue.content: Good. How does Brother want to verify?

text.content: 'Your bloodline power,' Chen Ji's gaze fell upon that fragment, 'what can it do?'

choices.description: The bloodline reunion can be discussed later; what's most important now is to understand why she appeared here and what the Holy Sect's scheme is.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the best opportunity to confirm identity
choices.visible_reward: Obtain intelligence on the Holy Sect
choices.risk_hint: May make Chen Nian feel Brother is too cold

text.content: Chen Ji forcefully suppressed the turmoil in his heart, burying that softness once more in the deepest recesses of his heart. 'These can be discussed later.' His voice recovered its usual coldness, 'Did the Holy Sect know you came here?'

dialogue.content: The Holy Sect thinks I'm still in seclusion. In truth, I used my bloodline power to briefly shield their perception. Brother, I came to find you because I discovered a secret even the Holy Sect doesn't know—about the Heavenly Fate Bloodline, about the Tianji Record, about the Heavenly Secrets' Eye.

text.content: Heavenly Secrets' Eye. Chen Ji's pupils slightly constricted. This name, he had heard in Mo Xiansheng's occasional fragments of words, but from the latter's secretive attitude, it was by no means an existence easily touched. 'Continue.'

The golden light grew more intense, forming visible ripples throughout the stone chamber. Mysterious runes began appearing around Chen Nian—those runes faintly resembled the inscriptions on the Tianji Record Fragment, yet were subtly different—if the Tianji Record's inscriptions represented 'Heaven's Mandate,' then the runes on Chen Nian's body represented 'Human Order.'

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Fate Key is not merely a key. The Holy Sect thought that by controlling me, they could control the exit of Heaven's Mandate's will. But they don't know—the true ability of the Heavenly Fate Bloodline is 'interference.' Brother, when you use the Tianji Record to foresee the future, are all the visions perfectly clear?

text.content: Chen Ji gave no answer, but his silence was the best affirmation. The Tianji Record's foresight had never erred; every vision was rendered in exquisite detail, every warning was precisely accurate—until he first saw Chen Nian. 'What are you getting at?'

dialogue.content: My existence is your blind spot in foresight. Brother, any foresight involving me will have blurred visions. This is not a flaw—this is the greatest bane of the Heavenly Secrets' Eye.

text.content: These words were like thunder, exploding in Chen Ji's mind. He had always assumed the blurred vision when the Tianji Record foresaw Chen Nian was some kind of restriction or limitation, never considering it could actually be the bane of the Heavenly Secrets' Eye. Mo Xiansheng had said the Tianji Record was Heaven's eye—so what was the Heavenly Secrets' Eye? What was the relationship between it and the Tianji Record?

choice.prompt: Chen Nian revealed that the Heavenly Fate Bloodline could interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight, and Chen Ji realized this was significant intelligence. How should he further test Chen Nian's sincerity?

choices.text: Honestly disclose the existence of the Tianji Record
choices.description: Since Chen Nian knows the relationship between the Tianji Record and Heavenly Secrets' Eye, perhaps she could become a true ally. Need to show some sincerity in exchange for her complete trust.
choices.visible_reward: Gain complete trust and ability support from the Heavenly Fate Bloodline holder
choices.risk_hint: If news leaks, will become the target of all

text.content: Chen Ji slowly drew the Tianji Record Fragment from his embrace; the yellowed page shimmered with a faint blue glow under the golden light. 'Is this what you're talking about?'

dialogue.content: Chen Nian's breath caught abruptly. She stared fixedly at that fragment of paper, and tears actually glistened in her eyes. 'Tianji Record... it's truly in your hands... Brother, do you know what you're holding?'

text.content: 'A volume of incomplete prophetic book.' Chen Ji said indifferently, 'Can foresee three hours into the future, but each use consumes Heavenly Fate Value.'

dialogue.content: It's more than a prophetic book. Brother, do you know how all previous Tianji Record holders died?

choices.text: Test her understanding of the Tianji Record
choices.description: Don't rush to expose oneself—first see how much she actually knows. A true ally doesn't need one to expose trump cards; the other party's intelligence speaks volumes.
choices.visible_reward: Avoid prematurely exposing the Tianji Record's existence
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian might view it as lacking sincerity

text.content: 'You seem very knowledgeable about the Tianji Record.' Chen Ji's voice carried no emotion whatsoever, 'Tell me, what else do you know?'

dialogue.content: Chen Nian was silent for a moment, as if considering how much to reveal. 'The Tianji Record is Heaven's eye, but it is merely one of the pieces. Brother, the Heavenly Secrets' Eye has laid many pieces in this world—the Tianji Record is merely the most dazzling one. And our Heavenly Fate Bloodline...'

text.content: She paused, her gaze sharpening. 'Is the only existence that can interfere with these pieces. The Holy Sect thought controlling me would allow them to use the Tianji Record—they don't know that the true variables are never on the chessboard— but in places the Chess Player cannot reach.'

choices.text: Inquire about the Heavenly Secrets' Eye's weakness
choices.description: The Heavenly Secrets' Eye is the ultimate enemy; if Chen Nian truly has methods to counter it, must clarify the specific means.
choices.visible_cost: Need to expose that one is currently opposing the Heavenly Secrets' Eye
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence on countering the Heavenly Secrets' Eye
choices.risk_hint: Exposing one's situation may cause Chen Nian's hesitation

text.content: 'Since you say the Heavenly Secrets' Eye is the bane of the Heavenly Fate Bloodline,' Chen Ji's voice lowered slightly, 'tell me specifically how it works.'

dialogue.content: A bitter smile curved Chen Nian's lips. 'The Heavenly Secrets' Eye can observe, interfere with, and control all things related to "Heaven's Mandate" in this world. But the existence of the Heavenly Fate Bloodline itself is a paradox—we are chosen by Heaven's Mandate, yet not bound by it. Brother, have you ever wondered why the Tianji Record chose you, and not someone else?'

text.content: This question made Chen Ji pause. He had always believed the Tianji Record chose him purely by chance, or rather, by fate's arrangement. But Chen Nian's words seemed to hint at deeper mysteries.

Chen Ji's thoughts raced like lightning. There were indeed too many suspicious points about why the Tianji Record chose him. His father Chen Xuan was the previous generation's candidate for inheritance, yet died mysteriously; he was a Chen family orphan, with mediocre talent yet inexplicably chosen. Heavenly Secrets' Eye, Mo Xiansheng, his father's death... among these threads of clues, there seemed to be a hidden line connecting them.

dialogue.content: Because in your blood flows a power of the same origin as the Tianji Record. Brother, you thought you were merely a chosen trash, but have you ever considered—the Tianji Record did not choose a 'trash,' but a 'Heaven's Mandate person'?

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He stared at Chen Nian, at the golden runes flowing across her body, and suddenly realized—if Chen Nian spoke truth, if the Tianji Record truly chose him because of his bloodline, then his self-proclaimed 'trash persona' he had been so proud of... was nothing but a self-deceiving joke? He thought he was incomparably scheming, advancing methodically, yet never knew that from the very beginning, he had already stood at the center of some enormous chessboard?

An unprecedented loneliness surged in his heart. So he had never been the Chess Player, never the one holding the pieces. He was merely a piece pushed by fate, the only difference being he possessed more clarity than other pieces. But was this clarity an advantage, or a greater tragedy?

choice.prompt: Chen Ji's faith was shaken; he needed to make a choice—continue the lone struggle, or accept this sister who might be a true ally?

choices.description: Fourteen years of separation is long enough; since blood connects us and she knows the inside story, perhaps it's time to trust this person once.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the full support of the Heavenly Fate Bloodline holder
choices.risk_hint: If judgment is wrong, will be ruined beyond recovery

text.content: Chen Ji was silent for a long moment before slowly extending his hand, grasping Chen Nian's wrist. It was warm to the touch; her pulse gradually synchronized with his heartbeat. That feeling of blood connection was more real than any oath. 'I trust you.' Three words, casually spoken, yet heavy as a thousand pounds.

dialogue.content: Chen Nian's eyes instantly reddened. She wanted to say something but found her throat too choked to produce sound. Fourteen years, and she had finally heard these three words. 'Brother...'

text.content: 'Don't cry.' Chen Ji's voice remained cold, yet the hand gripping her wrist tightened slightly, 'Crying solves nothing. Since you are the Heavenly Fate Bloodline, tell me next—who is the third person you mentioned?'

choices.text: Maintain cooperation but retain trump cards
choices.description: Can cooperate, but trust must be built slowly. The existence of the Tianji Record cannot be revealed for now; other abilities must also be held back.
choices.visible_cost: Cannot obtain Chen Nian's complete support
choices.risk_hint: May affect the depth of subsequent cooperation

text.content: Chen Ji released Chen Nian's wrist, stepped back, and his expression regained its cold composure. 'Cooperation is possible. But before that, I need to know more.' His voice was calm without a trace of fluctuation, 'The third person you mentioned—who is it?'

dialogue.content: Chen Nian's gaze dimmed slightly, but quickly recovered its clarity. 'Fine. Brother is willing to give me a chance; I'm already grateful.' She took a deep breath, 'The third person...'

text.content: She raised her head,直视 Chen Ji's eyes, speaking each word clearly: 'Is Chen Ling.'

choices.description: Cooperation benefits both, but terms and bottom lines must be clear. Be a small person first, then a gentleman, to ensure neither party is exploited.
choices.visible_reward: Ensure one's own interests are not infringed

text.content: 'Cooperation is possible, but I have conditions.' The corner of Chen Ji's mouth lifted in a cold smile, 'First—you are forbidden from inquiring about my trump cards. Second—you must obey my commands. Third—' He paused, 'If there is any sign of betrayal, I will personally end you.'

dialogue.content: Chen Nian listened quietly, without anger or grievance; instead, she smiled. 'Brother, your words are exactly what Father said back then.' A trace of longing flashed in her eyes, 'Indeed a Chen family member.'

text.content: 'You knew Father?' Chen Ji's gaze slightly chilled. 'Who is Chen Ling?'

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ling is Father's adopted daughter, also the third-generation inheritor of the Heavenly Fate Bloodline.' Chen Nian's voice was calm, yet carried complex emotions, 'She was adopted by the Tianqing Sect, and now is an Inner Disciple—and among Su Qingyao's most trusted people.'

text.content: Chen Ji's mind exploded with shock. Su Qingyao, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of the Tianqing Sect—the woman who had come infinitely close to the truth three times yet被他三次化解. And beside her, there was actually a Heavenly Fate Bloodline holder? And in the chess game he himself had set up, had there been a third eye watching all along? He had always thought himself the Chess Player, yet never imagined that above and beneath the chessboard, there were already layered mists upon mists.

dialogue.content: 'Does Chen Ling know her own origins?' Chen Ji's voice grew heavy. If Chen Ling was also a Heavenly Fate Bloodline holder, her sensing of the Tianji Record would far exceed ordinary people—had his previous careful caution before Su Qingyao already been seen through by this 'third eye'?

'She doesn't know.' Chen Nian shook her head, 'I only discovered this recently. Brother, Chen Ling's bloodline concentration is even higher than mine, just never activated. If she knew who she was...' She paused, 'Given her temperament, she might be even more dangerous than I am now.'

text.content: Chen Ji's fingertips tapped rhythmically against the Turtle Shell at his waist, neither fast nor slow. Su Qingyao, Chen Ling, Heavenly Fate Bloodline, Tianji Record... these seemingly unrelated clues were gradually connecting in his mind into an unprecedented chess game. If Chen Ling truly was a Heavenly Fate Bloodline holder, was her closeness to Su Qingyao coincidence or intentional? Was the Tianqing Sect's adoption of her protection or something else? What role did that old fox Ling Yuan play in all this?

He suddenly smiled. That smile was cold and aloof, yet carried a hint of relief even he hadn't noticed. Fourteen years, he had thought he walked alone in the darkness, yet there were companions on the same path after all. Fate had pushed him into this chess game; then he would turn the chess game upside down. The Heavenly Secrets' Eye wanted to use him as a piece? He would like to see—whether the piece's life was harder, or the Chess Player's hand steadier.
